title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Refuelling Pricing by Size of the Fuel Shortfall
content:
On Ridgeline Tool Rental equipment, the size of the fuel shortfall and the length of the rental set how the refuelling is priced.

**Pricing rule.** How the refuelling is priced depends on the shortfall: when 5 or more eighths are missing and the unit was out 7 or more calendar days, counted from the checkout date to the return date, the refuelling is priced as a full-tank refill at 85 percent of eight eighths at the class price per eighth, plus the service fee once; when 1 or 2 eighths are missing, the eighths missing are charged at the class price per eighth with no service fee; in every other case the eighths missing are charged at the class price per eighth plus the service fee once.

The days out are the calendar days from the date part of the checkout time to the date part of the return time. The class price per eighth and the service fee are those of the return fee schedule. The priced amount is not rounded on its own; the rounding to the cent is made only on the final figure.

## Pricing table

| Eighths missing | Days out | Priced as |
|---|---|---|
| 5 to 8 | 7 or more | 85 percent of 8 eighths at the class price, plus the service fee once |
| 5 to 8 | fewer than 7 | the eighths missing at the class price, plus the service fee once |
| 3 or 4 | any | the eighths missing at the class price, plus the service fee once |
| 1 or 2 | any | the eighths missing at the class price, no service fee |

## Worked figures (Ridgeline Rental Earthmoving and Compact Equipment: 18.00 per eighth, 15.00 service fee)

| Eighths missing | Out (hypothetical) | Priced refuelling |
|---|---|---|
| 6 | 2 to 11 March, 9 days | 85 percent of 144.00 is 122.40, plus 15.00: 137.40 |
| 6 | 2 to 7 March, 5 days | 108.00 plus 15.00: 123.00 |
| 5 | 2 to 9 March, 7 days | 122.40 plus 15.00: 137.40 |
| 3 | any | 54.00 plus 15.00: 69.00 |
| 2 | any | 36.00 |
